const scriptData = $('Execute Scriptwriting Pipeline').first().json.script;
const qa = scriptData.qa_report || {};

return {
  success: true,
  projectId: scriptData.project_id,
  scriptId: scriptData.id,
  topic: scriptData.topic,
  version: scriptData.script_version,
  approvalStatus: scriptData.approval_status,
  qaScore: qa.score,
  spokenWordCount: scriptData.spoken_word_count,
  estimatedDurationSeconds: scriptData.estimated_duration_seconds,
  titleOptions: scriptData.title_options,
  chaptersCount: scriptData.chapters.length,
  humorAnnotationsCount: scriptData.humor_annotations.length,
  memeSuggestionsCount: scriptData.meme_suggestions.length,
  visualSuggestionsCount: scriptData.visual_suggestions.length,
  contentHash: scriptData.content_hash,
  message: 'Phase 1, 2, and 3 executed end-to-end successfully! Narration script is generated, humor-adapted, QA-validated, and ready for human editorial review & Phase 4.'
};
